title: Dad Bought a Robot That Slaps Liars 🤖
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #robot #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: My dad came home with a robot. He said, this robot slaps anyone who tells a lie. Let's test it at dinner.
scenes.image: a strict father about 45 with glasses and a cardigan proudly placing a small cute white robot with a red light on its head and one mechanical arm on a family dinner table, a nervous 15-year-old boy with a backpack and a mother about 42 with curly hair, laughing staring

scenes.text: He looked at me and asked, where were you after school today?
scenes.image: a strict father about 45 with glasses and a cardigan staring suspiciously at a nervous 15-year-old boy with a backpack across the dinner table

scenes.text: I said, at the library. The robot reached over and slapped me right across the face.
scenes.image: a small cute white robot with a red light on its head and one mechanical arm slapping a nervous 15-year-old boy with a backpack at the dinner table, cartoon impact effect, dad looking satisfied

scenes.text: Okay, okay, I was at my friend's house playing video games. The robot stayed quiet.
scenes.image: a nervous 15-year-old boy with a backpack rubbing his cheek and confessing, a small cute white robot with a red light on its head and one mechanical arm calm with a green light

scenes.text: Dad smiled. You see, son? When I was your age, I never lied to my parents.
scenes.image: a strict father about 45 with glasses and a cardigan smugly lecturing with a raised finger

a small cute white robot with a red light on its head and one mechanical arm slapping a strict father about 45 with glasses and a cardigan, his glasses flying off, a nervous 15-year-old boy with a backpack shocked

scenes.text: Mom burst out laughing and said, well, he is your son after all.
scenes.image: a mother about 42 with curly hair, laughing laughing hard at the table

scenes.text: The robot slapped mom. We've been very quiet at dinner ever since.
scenes.image: a small cute white robot with a red light on its head and one mechanical arm slapping a mother about 42 with curly hair, laughing, then the whole family sitting silently with red cheeks, robot glowing
